summary: Competent HR Generalist and seasoned recruiter with an extensive background in HR Operations functions across large corporates. Through my progressive career, I have helped build HR operational efficiencies by meeting standards of excellence in end-to-end HR delivery.

Led salary negotiations, onboarding, and new hire orientation.
Advised managers on HR tools, policies, and procedures.
Handled background checks, records management, and diversity initiatives.
Facilitated performance management exercises and maintained HR metrics.
Managed separation processes, exit interviews, and off‑boarding programs.
Developed HR Scorecard and achieved best HR audit and recruitment turnaround awards.
